# Available steps

Generated by `npm run build` from the feature files in `src/components/` and the step definitions in `src/tests/_shared-steps/`. Edit those, not this file.

Every step a scenario can use, grouped by keyword and then by the file the step definition lives in. Reuse these before adding a new step.

## Given

### Samples load

- [`Given I load the sample "<input-url>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/1-Given/samples-load.js) — Loads a sample to test from a web URL.

## When

### Elements are focused

- [`When I focus "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element programmatically (without a keyboard press). Note: May not activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element using the keyboard. Note: Will activate :focus-visible styles.
- [`When I focus a link behind "<selector>" using a keyboard`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses a link behind the element (to check if focus indicator is visible). Note: The link is automatically injected and focused by the test.
- [`When I focus "<selector>" using the arrow keys`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-focused.js) — Focuses an element inside a component using arrow keys. For example: Components which use a roving tabindex pattern. Note: Will activate :focus-visible) styles.

### Elements are inspected

- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the DOM`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks element exists in the DOM, regardless of visibility on the page.
- [`When I inspect "<selector>" in the Accessibility Tree`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks an element exists in the accessibility tree.
- [`When it has the pseudo element "<pseudo-selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-inspected.js) — Checks if an element has a CSS pseudo element.

### Elements are viewed

- [`When I view the rendered "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/elements-are-viewed.js) — Checks an element is visibly rendered on the page.

### Keyboard events occur

- [`When I press the "<key>" key once`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Presses a key on the keyboard.
- [`When I hold the "<key>" key`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/keyboard-events-occur.js) — Holds a key on the keyboard.

### Mouse events occur

- [`When I press the mouse down on "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Holds the primary mouse button down on an element
- [`When I click on "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/mouse-events-occur.js) — Clicks an element with the primary mouse button

### Navigation occurs

- [`When I navigate to the fragment "<fragment>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/navigation-occurs.js) — Navigates to an anchor on the current page, as following a link to it would

### User settings are changed

- [`When I enable "<requested-mode>" mode`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Changes the colour mode in the browser. For example: light, dark, forced colours.
- [`When I preview the page for printing`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Previews the page as it would print, so print styles apply
- [`When I switch to landscape mode`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Simulates landscape mode by swapping the browser's width and height. Note: This is a preview based on proportions rather than true landscape mode. Orientation media queries, screen.orientation and other device metadata will not change.
- [`When I zoom in the browser to <zoom-percent>%`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Changes the zoom level in the browser.
- [`When I set the viewport to <width>px wide`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Sets the viewport width in the browser.
- [`When I set the viewport to <width>px by <height>px`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Sets both the width and height of the viewport in the browser.
- [`When I increase the line height to <multiplier> times the font size`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Increases the line height.
- [`When I increase the spacing following paragraphs to <multiplier> times the font size`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Increases the line spacing following paragraphs.
- [`When I increase the letter spacing to <multiplier> times the font size`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Increases the letter spacing.
- [`When I increase the word spacing to <multiplier> times the font size`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Increases the word spacing.
- [`When I apply a custom foreground and background colour using a user stylesheet`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Overrides the foreground and background colours using a custom stylesheet.
- [`When I apply a custom max-width using a user stylesheet`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Overrides the max width using a custom stylesheet.
- [`When I apply a custom text-alignment using a user stylesheet`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Overrides the text alignment using a custom stylesheet.
- [`When I apply a custom line height using a user stylesheet`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Overrides the line-height of the font using a custom stylesheet.
- [`When I apply a custom font size of 200% using a user stylesheet`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/2-When/user-settings-are-changed.js) — Resizes the font to 200% using a custom stylesheet.

## Then

### Content checks

- [`Then it should have an accessible name which contains the visible label "<visible-label>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Automatically checks if the label is in the accessible name.
- [`Then the content should be readable and usable`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if the content is readable.
- [`Then it should not use instructions which rely on the visual layout`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if sensory characteristics are used in content.
- [`Then it should be easy to understand the purpose of each link from its text and surrounding context`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if link text makes sense in context.
- [`Then it should be easy to understand the purpose of each link from its text alone`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if link text makes sense in isolation.
- [`Then it should be easy to understand the expected input from the label text`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if a the label is descriptive.
- [`Then it should be easy to understand the topic or purpose from the label text`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/content-checks.js) — Manual check to see if a label describes topic or purpose.

### Context checks

- [`Then it should navigate to a new page`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/context-checks.js) — Automatically checks that context changes to another page. Note: Validates the page content actually changes.
- [`Then it should NOT navigate to a new page`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/context-checks.js) — Automatically checks that context does NOT change to another page. Note: Validates the page content stays the same.
- [`Then the URL should change`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/context-checks.js) — Automatically checks that the URL changes. Note: Does not validate the page content actually changes.

### Contrast checks

- [`Then its text should have a contrast ratio of "<min-ratio>" against its background`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/contrast-checks.js) — Automatically checks the colour of text against its background colour.
- [`Then its pseudo element should have a contrast ratio of "<min-ratio>" against its background`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/contrast-checks.js) — Automatically checks the colour of CSS pseudo content against its background colour.
- [`Then its selected state box-shadow or border should have a contrast ratio of "<min-ratio>" against its background`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/contrast-checks.js) — Automatically checks the contrast of a box-shadow or border used to indicate that an element is selected, against it's background. Note: Used for comparing indicators drawn inside of a selected element, against it's own background.
- [`Then its selected state box-shadow or border should have a contrast ratio of "<min-ratio>" against the "<adjacent-selector>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/contrast-checks.js) — Automatically checks the contrast of a box-shadow or border used to indicate that an element is selected, against another element. Note: Used for comparing indicators drawn inside of a selected element, against adjacent unselected elements.

### Focus checks

- [`Then "<selector>" should be focused`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is currently focused.
- [`Then the focus should not be on a "<selector>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element is NOT currently focused.
- [`Then it should have a visible focus indicator`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a visible focus indicator. Note: Only checks for for outline or box-shadow.
- [`Then its focus indicator should be at least partially visible`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the focus indicator is at least partially visible.
- [`Then its focus indicator should be fully visible`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the focus indicator is fully visible.
- [`Then it should not have any part of its focus indicator covered by "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks that a named element does not cover any part of the focus indicator.
- [`Then it should not have its focus indicator entirely covered by "<selector>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks that a named element does not cover the focus indicator entirely.
- [`Then the focus indicator should have a contrast ratio of 3:1 against its background`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the contrast ratio of the focus indicator.
- [`Then its focus indicator should have a minimum perimiter thickness of 2px`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/focus-checks.js) — Automatically checks the thickess of the focus indicator.

### Image checks

- [`Then it should contain static text, not an image`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element contains static text and no image nodes.
- [`Then it should not contain any images`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element contains no images or CSS background images. Note: A component with no images passes 1.4.5 and 1.4.9. If a component needs an image, use the manual images of text steps instead.
- [`Then it should not contain images of text which should have been rendered as actual text`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Manual check to see if there are images of text which do not fit the exemption criteria.
- [`Then it should not contain any images of text at all`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Manual check to see if there are any images of text at all.
- [`Then any icon should have a text description, or be hidden from assistive technologies`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/image-checks.js) — Automatically checks each icon is hidden from assistive technologies when a text label exists, or has a text description when it doesn't. Note: An icon which carries its own description also records a manual checklist, so a person can judge the wording.

### Keyboard checks

- [`Then every interactive control should be reachable using the keyboard`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/keyboard-checks.js) — Automatically checks every rendered control inside the element receives focus when sweeping with Tab, and with the arrow keys inside composite widgets such as a tab list. Note: Open or expand the component first, so the controls you want checked are rendered.

### Markup checks

- [`Then it is positioned after the "<previous-el>" element in the DOM`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automaically checks if an element is positioned after another in the DOM.
- [`Then it should use valid HTML with no parsing errors`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks the HTML is valid.
- [`Then it should have an accessible name`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element just has an accessible name.
- [`Then its accessible name should be "<accessible-name>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks the accessible name matches a given string.
- [`Then its accessible name and visible text should be identical`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that the accessible name is identical to the visible text.
- [`Then it should use the tag "<tag>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element uses a specific HTML tag.
- [`Then it should have an accessible role of "<role>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a particular role.
- [`Then it should have the attribute "<attribute>" with the value "<value>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element has a particular attribute and value.
- [`Then it should contain the text "<text>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element's text includes some expected text, including text which is visually hidden.
- [`Then it should not contain the text "<text>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element's text does not include some text, including text which is visually hidden.
- [`Then it should have the attribute "<attribute>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element has a particular attribute Note: The value is not checked in this test
- [`Then it should not have the attribute "<attribute>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element does NOT have a particular attribute
- [`Then it should be nested within the "<ancestor-selector>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/markup-checks.js) — Automatically checks that an element is a descendant of another element.

### Visual checks

- [`Then it should reflow without requiring horizontal scrolling`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks there is no horizontal scrolling.
- [`Then it should not lose any content or functionality`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks nothing was lost after a user setting changed, such as zoom, text spacing, orientation, a user stylesheet or forced colours. Note: Fails on clipped text, overlapping content, horizontal scrolling, collapsed or covered controls, and ignored user stylesheet preferences.
- [`Then it is "<position>" aligned visually to the "<previous>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if elements are visually aligned.
- [`Then it should be to the left of the text in the "<reference>" element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element sits entirely to the left of the visible text in another element. Note: Use for icons which should appear before a label.
- [`Then it should be visually identifiable as a link without relying on colour alone`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks a link for a reliance on colour. Note: Checks for underlines, borders and font-weight
- [`Then it should be distinguishable from "<reference>" without relying on colour alone`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element can be told apart from another without colour, by comparing text decoration, weight, borders, outlines, shadows, background images, generated content and icons. Note: Use for a selected tab against an unselected one, or the current page against another page.
- [`Then it should not rely on colour to convey information`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Manual check to see if an element for a reliance on colour. Note: For more complicated components other than links.
- [`Then it should have a width and height of at least 44px`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a target size of at least 44px. Note: Could cause false positives if used on things like inline links.
- [`Then it should have a width and height of at least 24px`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks an element has a target size of at least 24px. Note: Could cause false positives if used on things like inline links.
- [`Then it should have a visible separator between elements using a '::before' element`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if an element has a CSS pseudo separator.
- [`Then it should have the CSS property "<prop>" with the value "<value>"`](../../src/tests/_shared-steps/3-then/visual-checks.js) — Automatically checks if an element has a certain CSS property and value.
